items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Leo Dejan when he was playing on the boat with Dirty Pope... [INTERVIEWEE] He said, now, didn't I tell you that? No, you can't play nothing.

ctx.x: Elliot Taylor, Arthur Durbny, Elliot Taylor, Arthur Durbny, and who else? Three of them. And Joe Ruzon.
Uh-huh. Joe Phillips. Uh-huh. Joe Phillips and Leo.
